verdict.rationale: The portal names a sanctioned third-party channel: a dedicated services area for Contabilistas Certificados (certified accountants) [at-financas-docs-8]. It also lets users sign up for electronic notifications either in their own name or 'em representação' (as a representative) [at-financas-docs-1]. Both are only homepage link labels, with no documentation of how a provider is authorized, registered or scoped to act for a company. Missing for 10: documented process for appointing or registering a representative or designee, scope and permissions of delegated access, revocation and audit details, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
